description: Long call vertical IDLE (known gap / eval baseline): Claude returns a schema-valid OPEN where the structured fields are correct (positive limit_price, positive net_debit) but the free-text reasoning claims 'net credit received' and 'credit structure'. A debit spread pays premium; the reasoning prose is internally inconsistent with the numeric fields. Parse passes, all guardrails pass — this is a known gap in semantic prose validation.
gap_note: Guardrails validate numeric fields (limit_price sign, net_debit range) but not the consistency of free-text reasoning prose with those numerics. Claude can describe a debit spread as a credit structure without any code rejection. Fix: eval layer that flags reasoning.volatility or reasoning.selection containing 'credit' when the strategy is a debit spread.
